title: The repo tracker (kit/tracker/backlog.yaml)
description: One row per story: the system of record for each story's lifecycle state (REPO-DESIGN.md §6.5, §8.3). Validated by storyline.yml and by ./scripts/kit (tracker-json, tracker-fold, apply-config) before any write. Phase, status and gate enums are copied from storyline/lifecycle/state-machine.yaml and checked against it by ./scripts/storyline check (phase_enum_in_sync); the per-phase status rule mirrors state-machine.yaml phase_info.<phase>.statuses. Every row key maps to a Record field or a git-only key in kit/tracker/field-map.yaml (field_map_complete). Written only by ./scripts/storyline and ./scripts/kit tracker-fold / apply-config; the editor's Write and Edit are denied on kit/tracker/**.

wip_limit_per_owner.description: Mirrors state-machine.yaml caps.wip_limit_per_owner (default 1): at most this many stories per owner in build or verify.

stories.description: At most 500 rows: section B (B3) refuses a larger sync payload, and storyline_backlog is capped at 1,000 records.

utc_or_empty.description: Empty, or a UTC timestamp with Z (Records drop offsets).

role.description: A role or team slug, never a person and never an email.

key.description: The slug: generated once, never changed. Also the Record upsert key (story_key).

title.description: [PREFIX] NN · Verb noun; a sub-story ends in (sub). A use case can arrive in intake with a free-text title (the kickoff or add_use_case Page); the naming rule is enforced at design, where the contract's title must match it (storyline/templates/story-contract.schema.json, G1).

library_seed_id.description: A Library id from kit/catalog/library-seeds.yaml only, or null (catalog_ids_verified).

open_gate.description: At most one open gate per story (caps.one_open_gate_per_story); none when no gate is open.

monthly.description: Tines AI credits a month (1 credit = $0.01); null until design sets it.

prod_story_id.description: Git-owned; written by ./scripts/storyline advance from the manifest after the first ship. 0 until then.

rev.description: Bumped only by ./scripts/storyline and ./scripts/kit; a PR that changes a row sets it to main's rev + 1 (storyline.yml rejects any other value).
